mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or 20-day forward returns in downturns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real GDP growth signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations adjust downward.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of declining GDP are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production by more than 2% within a month signals a strong supply-side response, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% within the same month, it signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or 5-day forward returns in strong labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% within a month, it signals inflationary pressure under loose monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure under loose monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or 20-day forward returns in inflationary periods under loose monetary policy are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% within a month signals a weakening in the housing market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the broader economic demand weakens.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or 60-day forward returns in housing market downturns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations improve.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of increasing RSAFS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
